levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: counts the odds before it raises

help.goal: Be the last player still holding dice, by bidding on what is under everyone's cups and calling the bluffs.
steps: Only you see your own dice; bids cover every die on the table.
Tap − and + to set the quantity, then tap a face.
Tap Bid 3 ⚅ to claim that many dice are showing.
Do not believe the bid? Tap Liar! (dudo).
Whoever was wrong loses a die; at zero dice you are out.
notes: Ones are wild and count towards every face, which is why you can never bid on ones.
Each bid must beat the one before it: a higher quantity, or the same quantity on a higher face.
Calling Liar ends the round immediately and reveals every cup, so there is no bidding after it.
